mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile: the result brings breathing, blood and distant working cells together in one route.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the breathing muscles and then attaching them to the lungs felt somewhat repetitive, since both steps were predictable and each was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The final diagram made the route through the right heart, lungs, left heart and body more explicit than I had expected.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless. The menu supplied compatible partners, though, so I did not have to work out which parts would fit.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the connected body systems support an action, although I would hope for more meaningful choices than the sequence of single options near the end.
